verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions documentation that banks or payment processors accept as proof of business address. Stable says only that the address can be used "with the IRS, the state, vendors, and more," which is an adjacent claim, not a proof-of-address document. There is also no statement of where the address is not accepted. USPS Form 1583 is part of mailbox onboarding, not bank-facing proof of address.
